settings.heading: Three ways to work together
settings.text: Every client starts with the same free call. Then we pick what fits where you are now. Many companies pay for it from a training budget.
settings.note: Buying for several managers at your company? Ask about company rates

settings.label: One to one
settings.title: Monthly coaching
settings.text: Two calls a month and messages in between, for managers who want someone in their corner.
settings.points:
Two 60 minute calls a month
Messages answered within a working day
A one page plan we update each month
Stop or pause any month

settings.image_alt: Mateo at a whiteboard, arms crossed
settings.label: Small group
settings.title: First 90 Days
settings.text: Eight new managers, eight weeks, one topic a week: delegation, feedback, one to ones, meetings, hiring and the plan.
settings.points:
Eight live sessions on video
A workbook for each week
Two one to one calls with me
A group of managers to stay in touch with

settings.label: For your team
settings.title: Team day
settings.text: A full day with you and your team on how you work together: roles, meetings, decisions and the next quarter.
settings.points:
A call with you before the day
Six hours together, in person or online
Everything agreed, written up within a week
A follow up call after 30 days

settings.heading: Let's look at your week
settings.text: Twenty minutes on video. You tell me about your team; I say honestly whether I can help.
settings.note: No pitch. If we are not a fit, I will say so.
settings.name: Mateo Cruz
settings.points:
Where your team is now
What is taking your time
One next step, either way
